statement.notes: The primary cash flow statement provides a single line item for 'Depreciation and amortization' for each year. The supplementary tables contain detailed lease information (Note 18) which includes components like 'Net rental expense' and amortization of right-of-use assets, but these are not separate line items that sum to the total 'Depreciation and amortization' reported in the main statement. Therefore, only the primary line item is mapped. The scale is in millions (1E6) as indicated by '(in millions)' in the statement header.
